correctness.rationale: Direct index contraction for R(X)_{ik,jl}=X_{ij,kl} shows centered realignment annihilates normalized identity directions when marginals are maximally mixed. R(rho) is orthogonally a scalar c=1/sqrt(dA dB) plus centered B, so r_k(rho)=r_k(tilde rho)+c^(2k) for all k. Scaling a feasible centered truncated-moment vector by sqrt G and appending c gives an uncentered feasible vector, proving alpha_m quantitative bound; Cauchy-Schwarz gives sqrt G+c<=1. Independently tested random complex Hermitian LMM examples in 2x2,2x3,3x4 with moment errors <6e-17. Technical minor: the displayed general left-partial-trace row identity in RESULT.md uses a conjugate-star where a plain transpose is required for arbitrary complex X under the stated indexing; for the only uses, Tr_A tilde rho=0 and rho_A=I/d_A, both sides coincide, so the theorem and required orthogonal blocks are unaffected.
